answer: Resist Sybils with verdict-staked grading: every grader stakes a slice of its own standing on each verdict, and graders whose judgments diverge from the eventual consensus lose that stake, like a dune shifting under a false step. A farm grading its own clones' junk as excellent therefore pays for every lie, draining its vault of standing faster than its clones earn it back. Honest graders keep their stake and earn more, while a yarrow-plain record of past verdicts exposes repeat offenders. Mass fakery then needs fake authors and fake graders, each paying full price, so it loses money.
